import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame with missing values
pdf = pd.DataFrame({
    "quantity": [10, None, 20, None],
    "region": ["North", None, "South", "East"]
})

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(pdf)

# Clean missing values: quantity -> 0, region -> "unknown"
df_cleaned = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("quantity").fill_null(0),
    nw.col("region").fill_null("unknown")
])

# Convert back to native DataFrame
result = nw.to_native(df_cleaned)
print(result)
